runtimePlacementAuthority.description: HomeAssets, PlazaAssets and AssetReview are editable inspection snapshots. The WebGL build includes the canonical MagicVillage scene; VillageRuntime constructs positions through VillageWorld and VillageArt instantiates serialized library prefab references. Editing snapshot placement alone does not change runtime world placement. Prefab/art changes may affect both snapshot instances and runtime references after a rebuild.

limitations: File hashes describe the capture time; final WebGL binaries and compiled runtime source hashes are verified in separate build receipts.
All 62 assets have independently authored prefabs and review snapshot instances. This does not assert that all 62 are simultaneously rendered in a single player scene.
The 14 reward PNGs and three UI PNGs are used by the surrounding HTML learning interface; only the earned-flower bloom reward is instantiated by the Unity world.
